body:
Code Review by Qodo

🐞 Bugs (1) 📘 Rule violations (0) 📜 Skill insights (0)
1. Trusted host validation removed 🐞 Bug ⛨ Security
>
>Description >
> >
>create_url_adapter no longer applies TRUSTED_HOSTS or validates the incoming Host, and no
>replacement enforcement exists in Flask's request class. Applications relying on this setting will
>accept untrusted hosts, exposing host-derived URLs and redirects to Host-header manipulation.
>
>
>
>Code >
> >[src/flask/app.py[L449-450]](https://github.com/seonho12-54/qodo-coderabbit-benchmark/pull/6198/files#diff-d3e0349504081bb501c611b3954be364188a4cf442056181272e27e830ae446eL449-L450) > >```diff >- # Check trusted_hosts here until bind_to_environ does. >- request.host = get_host(request.environ, request.trusted_hosts) # pyright: ignore >``` >
>
>Evidence >
> >
>The current default configuration no longer declares TRUSTED_HOSTS, and create_url_adapter now
>binds directly to the raw WSGI environment without applying or validating a trusted-host list.
>Flask's Request merely subclasses Werkzeug's request wrapper without replacing host handling,
>while request-context construction treats only exceptions actually raised during adapter creation as
>routing errors; therefore a valid but untrusted Host now proceeds normally.
>
> > [src/flask/app.py[177-207]](https://github.com/seonho12-54/qodo-coderabbit-benchmark/blob/8c5bc970133eae9a89835fb6a1ddb1e3e80cd2ce/src/flask/app.py/#L177-L207) > [src/flask/app.py[443-459]](https://github.com/seonho12-54/qodo-coderabbit-benchmark/blob/8c5bc970133eae9a89835fb6a1ddb1e3e80cd2ce/src/flask/app.py/#L443-L459) > [src/flask/wrappers.py[18-28]](https://github.com/seonho12-54/qodo-coderabbit-benchmark/blob/8c5bc970133eae9a89835fb6a1ddb1e3e80cd2ce/src/flask/wrappers.py/#L18-L28) > [src/flask/ctx.py[317-326]](https://github.com/seonho12-54/qodo-coderabbit-benchmark/blob/8c5bc970133eae9a89835fb6a1ddb1e3e80cd2ce/src/flask/ctx.py/#L317-L326) >
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >The PR removes the only enforcement of Flask's `TRUSTED_HOSTS` configuration, causing configured host restrictions to be silently ignored. > >## Issue Context >Restore the default configuration entry and ensure the configured trusted-host list is applied before routing binds to the request environment. If host handling is moved into `Request`, account for request-context construction occurring before the application context is pushed, and add coverage proving an untrusted Host receives a 400 response. > >## Fix Focus Areas >- src/flask/app.py[177-207] >- src/flask/app.py[423-459] >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
Context sources
Review mode: ⚖️ Balanced: This removes request host validation and the TRUSTED_HOSTS default from Flask’s request URL handling, creating security-relevant behavioral risk despite the small localized diff.

### The AI Code Review Platform

## Get Started
Simply sign into Github and click the "Configure" button. Check out our documentation for more info: https://docs.qodo.ai/get-started.

## Overview
Qodo automatically reviews every GitHub pull request, identifies logic bugs, edge cases, security issues, and code quality problems, and provides actionable suggestions your team can apply immediately.

Install in minutes. Integrates seamlessly into your existing workflows.

## Qodo is designed for developers who:
- Handle frequent pull requests and need reliable review coverage
- Balance code quality with fast delivery
- Work in complex, multi-repo systems
- Use AI-generated code and need stronger guardrails
- Build production software where reliability matters

## Qodo Capabilities
- ## Automated PR Analysis
  - Reviews every pull request automatically
  - No manual trigger required

- ## Context-Aware Code Review
  - Understands cross-file changes
  - Detects architectural inconsistencies

- ## Actionable Suggestions
